notes: The HPO pipeline as ONE workflow manifest: search (candidate lanes over the warmup folds of W1) -> freeze (hpo-frozen.json: the selected model and its full hyperparameters) -> evaluate (default vs frozen winner over the later W1 folds). Run: `python -m dskit.pipeline workflow configs/workflow-hpo.json --args hpo-args.json` where hpo-args.json is a FLAT overlay of the manifest args, e.g. {"pick": "<path to zoo-pick.json>"} (do not wrap it in an "args" key: that leaves the args unfilled). It reads no W2. The lane manifests it writes sit under the work dir. Regenerate with `python -m crypto_trading.zoo_lanes configs/zoo-lanes-recipe.json --out ... --hpo-out configs/workflow-hpo.json`; a test pins it. Note the workflow ledger keys a step on its config and its in-values, which name the pick by path: after re-picking, delete the work dir.

args.notes: `pick` is the zoo's zoo-pick.json (unfilled until --args supplies it); `recipe` is this recipe as run from the child root; `parallel` is workflow-batch's lane parallelism (two lanes at once).

search.notes: Write the candidate lanes of the picked cell, then run them over the warmup folds.

freeze.notes: Take the lowest warmup mean (the default wins ties) and write its full params.

evaluate.notes: Default vs the frozen winner over the folds after the warmup, then the paired comparison.

freeze.notes: Refuses unless every search lane is ok.

evaluate.notes: No search node: both cells are fixed, the folds are the schedule's remaining ones.
